Research done (read-only, 8 tool calls). What I actually read: `docs/research/mobile-sync.md`, `packages/desktop/src/host/index.ts`, `packages/desktop/src/main/desktopWindowLifecycle.ts`, `packages/desktop/src/main/desktopRemoteSessions.ts`, `packages/server/src/http.ts`, plus grep sweeps over the repo for the three terms.

- **Connection model**: a phone is meant to attach to the *window Host* (one per window, shared by renderer and phone) rather than talk to the agent directly. Main posts `AttachServicePort` with a fresh `MessageChannel` pair to the Host process, and the Host handler (`packages/desktop/src/host/index.ts:2734-2771`) registers it via `windowHostAttachmentRegistry.attach` with `{clientMode, scope}` — the comment at `:2740` explicitly says "刷新/手机 attachment 复用同一 Host", so a phone attachment reuses the existing executor instead of starting a second one. `clientMode` is either `desktop-continuous` or `web-remote-replayable` (schema in `packages/shared/src/validation.ts:260-267`); a phone would be `web-remote-replayable`.
- **Who issues the port today**: only three call sites exist. Renderer reload reattaches with `clientMode:"desktop-continuous"`, `scope:{kind:"local"}` (`packages/desktop/src/main/desktopWindowLifecycle.ts:143-160`); remote-workspace renderer attachment uses `scope:{kind:"remote", remoteSessionId, workspacePath, workspaceIdentity}` with `desktop-continuous` (`packages/desktop/src/main/desktopRemoteSessions.ts:295-319`); and the only `web-remote-replayable` issuer is the Bot path `attachRemoteWorkspaceSessionHost` / `createBotRemoteWorkspaceRuntimePort` (`desktopRemoteSessions.ts:881-941`, `:973-998`), which still requires an already-connected remote workspace route.
- **Role of `remoteSessionId`**: it identifies a *remote workspace logical session* (a CodeZ workspace reached over a remote target), and is carried inside the `scope` of the `AttachServicePort` message. The Host validates it (`waitForScopedServices` for `scope.kind === "remote"`, `host/index.ts:2748-2751`), and on disposal removes the source keyed by `{kind:"remote", remoteSessionId, ...}` (`host/index.ts:2700-2713`). Scope/identity mismatch closes the port rather than falling back (`host/index.ts:2764-2769`) — so a phone session on the local machine would use `scope:{kind:"local"}`, and only phones attached to a remote-target workspace would carry a `remoteSessionId`.
- **Still missing — the phone transport (G1)**: there is no code path that takes an inbound phone connection and issues it an `AttachServicePort` with `web-remote-replayable`. Grep found no pairing/QR/relay listener anywhere in `packages/desktop/src`, and the "Mobile remote control" UI only opens Bot channel config (WeChat/Feishu/Lark/Telegram) — `packages/ui/src/WebRemoteControlDialog.tsx`. Per `docs/research/mobile-sync.md` §1.2 G1 and the plan in §4.3, a Main-side "phone gateway" (WebSocket or relay channel → authenticated `AttachServicePort{clientMode:"web-remote-replayable", scope:{kind:"local"}}`) must be written.
- **Still missing — shared Host vs. standalone server (G2) and auth (G5)**: the standalone HTTP server is a *separate* Host — `packages/server/src/http.ts:325-332` upgrades `/ws` into `setupChannelServer(..., "web-remote-replayable")` against its own `createLocalServices` (its own `AcpV4Bridge`), gated only by a static bearer/cookie token (`http.ts:307-318`), with `/ws/host` requiring a one-shot capability header (`http.ts:334-346`). A phone connecting there would not see the desktop window's ACP sessions. There is no pairing, per-device identity, revocation, or E2E encryption (mobile-sync.md G5).
- **Still missing — efficiency and verification (G3, G6, G7)**: `AcpV4Bridge.publishTo` sends a full snapshot with `fromSeq:0` on every ACP `session/update`, so cost grows with transcript size × subscribers — tolerable over a MessagePort, not over mobile data (mobile-sync.md §1.2 G3; fix plan §4.2 coalescing + row deltas). Also absent: push notifications for pending permissions (G6) and any test of two concurrent ACP subscribers / permission answered on one end / mid-turn replayable reconnect (G7) — the only `web-remote-replayable` tests found are `packages/services/test/nonCliAcpRetirement.test.ts` and `importedClaudeRecovery.test.ts`, both on the legacy snapshot path.
